newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Chocolate Products in China beer venture.
newsitem.headline: Chocolate Products in China beer venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Chocolate Products Bhd said on Wednesday it has entered into a joint venture to manufacture beer in China.

Chocolate Products, through wholly-owned Consitrade (M) Sdn Bhd, will hold 60 percent equity in the joint venture while the remaining 40 percent will be held by China's Zibo Hengli Brewery, the company said in a statement.
The joint venture company will be capitalised at $9.64 million.
Chocolate Products currently has investments in eight other breweries in China.

"The brewery projects have achieved profit higher than what was expected and the current joint venture is a natural extension of Chocolate Products' existing beer business in China," the statement said.
